_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for the audio area. Audio and DSP - devices, levels, transmit audio, filters, noise reduction. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. A key whose text is missing is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. LADDERS: a key may hold three tiers instead of one string - critical, terse and chatty - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. This partition is empty; the extraction tracks fill it. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.
_track_f: The keys below are Sprint 34 Track F's: the audio-device gate that every road to PC audio passes through at connect time (globals.vb). They live in this partition because they are audio wording, not connect vocabulary.
audio.startup.picker_failed: The audio device chooser could not open: {message}
audio.startup.enumeration_failed: Radio audio cannot start: this computer's sound devices could not be read.
audio.startup.device_missing: The sound device you chose for radio audio, {gone}, is not connected.
audio.startup.no_device_chosen: Radio audio needs a sound device on this computer and none has been chosen yet.
audio.startup.declined: Radio audio is off. Choose devices any time from Settings, Audio, Audio Devices.

audio.silent_tx.warning.critical: No mic profile on this radio. Audio from your computer will not be transmitted.
audio.silent_tx.warning.terse: This radio has no mic profile selected, so audio from your computer will not be transmitted through your radio. Nothing you did caused it.
audio.silent_tx.warning.chatty: Heads up: this radio has no mic profile selected. Until one is loaded, audio from your computer will not be transmitted through your radio — you would key up and nobody would hear you. Nothing you did caused it, and receive is unaffected. The Audio Workshop has the details.

audio.silent_tx.repaired: This radio had no mic profile selected, so audio from your computer would not have been transmitted through your radio. I loaded {candidate} on the radio.
audio.device.no_usable: Radio audio cannot start: this computer has no usable {role} device. Open Settings, Audio, Audio Devices to choose one.
audio.device.saved_missing_fallback: Your saved {role} device, {savedName}, is not connected. Using the system default, {fallbackName}.
audio.device.none_chosen_fallback: No {role} device was chosen yet. Using the system default, {fallbackName}. You can change it in Settings, Audio, Audio Devices.
audio.mic.could_not_open: Your microphone could not be opened, so computer audio will not transmit. Receive audio is working. Check your input device in Audio Devices.
audio.mic.diverged: The radio switched its transmit audio to the {current} input while computer audio was running. Setting it back to PC.
audio.silent_tx.advisory: This radio has no mic profile selected. A mic profile is the radio's own transmit-audio chain, and without one loaded, audio sent from this computer has nothing to travel through — you would key up and nobody would hear you. Receiving is unaffected, and nothing you did caused it: a radio arrives this way from the factory, and loading a global profile that carries no mic profile leaves it this way too.
audio.silent_tx.advisory_suggestion: This radio offers a mic profile named {pick}.
